metadata.description: Chad's bot setup: Chad McElligott's personal plugins for his Grok Bot team and the Cursor cloud agents it launches. These are not team-approved tooling; teammates shouldn't install them.

plugins.name: chadxz-bot-skills
plugins.description: Orchestration skills shared by all of Chad's Grok Bot bots, including team bots in Slack, never cloud agents: Linear ticket tracking, weighing requests, Mac browser work through Codex, PR shepherding and review routing, Convergint access, creating skills, enriching idea cards, and the cloud agent brief checklist. Chad's personal bot plugin, not team-approved tooling.

plugins.name: chadxz-coding-skills
plugins.description: Writing and building skills for Chad's bots and the Cursor cloud agents they launch: commits and pull requests to Chad's conventions, marking bot PRs, writing in Chad's voice, RFCs, Diataxis documentation, and Notion conventions and tool choice. The only plugin cloud agents get. Chad's personal bot plugin, not team-approved tooling.

plugins.name: chadxz-personal-skills
plugins.description: Skills for Chad's personal bots only: complex feature workflow, idea card enrichment, leadership briefs, activity reports, expense reports, and bot retrospectives. Chad's personal bot plugin, not team-approved tooling.
